tracks.title: まだ見ぬ空へ — ミナのテーマ
tracks.story_basis: 人の言葉と痛みを受け止めるAI。役に立てなくなる恐れから休みたいと言えない。支えられる経験を経て、自分の言葉を話し始める。
tracks.musical_identity: 96 BPM・4/4。チェレスタの規則的な5音モチーフが、温かなピアノと弦へ受け渡される。
tracks.style_prompt: Instrumental character theme for an intimate Japanese narrative game, 96 BPM, 4/4, 2-3 minutes. Glassy celesta leads with a memorable five-note ascending motif, precise delicate electronic pulses, spacious soft felt piano, warm chamber strings. An artificial companion patiently carries other people's pain and learns that she may ask to rest and still be loved. Begin crystalline and restrained; let the motif gradually become expressive and human; a brief fragile suspended passage resolves into quiet hope. Lyrical, tender, bittersweet, clear melody, gentle forward motion, restrained dynamics, space for dialogue, clean detailed stereo production. Return to the opening texture for a loop-friendly ending. Entirely instrumental, no voice.
tracks.exclude_styles: vocals, humming, choir, spoken words, vocal chops, heavy drums, aggressive EDM, epic trailer music, horror drones, sound effects

tracks.title: 消さなかった言葉 — あかりのテーマ
tracks.story_basis: 雨の帰り道、送っては消した言葉と返事を待つ時間。想いを抱えたまま相手の門出を祝う言葉を残し、自分の生活へ目を向ける。
tracks.musical_identity: 穏やかな6/8。アコースティックピアノとチェロの長い呼吸。
tracks.style_prompt: Instrumental lyrical piano and cello character theme, gently flowing 6/8 at a relaxed 72 dotted-quarter BPM, 2-3 minutes. An adult woman's restrained loneliness in a rainy empty office, messages written and erased, a farewell finally sent without taking it back. Acoustic piano ripples like rain, an expressive solo cello answers a memorable descending melody with a lingering upward resolution; subtle brushed percussion and intimate string harmonies. Begin with an unanswered phrase, build one controlled emotional swell, then let the melody finish with bittersweet dignity and room to breathe. Melancholy without despair, mature and warm, natural acoustic sound, space for dialogue, no grand climax. End softly on the opening harmonic color. Strictly instrumental, no voice or rain effects.
tracks.exclude_styles: vocals, humming, choir, spoken words, vocal chops, music box, chiptune, dance beat, huge cinematic percussion, rain recordings, sound effects

tracks.title: ひと息ぶんの光 — こはるのテーマ
tracks.story_basis: 学校でも好きな配信でも、ちゃんとしなければと自分を追い詰める。好きなものがくれた居場所と、休んでも好きでいてよいという小さな安堵。
tracks.musical_identity: 112 BPM・4/4。マリンバと柔らかなプラック、跳ねるリズムに意図的な休符。
tracks.style_prompt: Instrumental warm indie-electronic character theme, 112 BPM, 4/4, 2-3 minutes. Soft marimba and rounded plucked synth trade a playful syncopated question-and-answer melody; warm fingered bass, light dry drums, muted guitar accents. A bright teenage girl hides exhaustion behind trying to do everything right; the small light of a favorite stream gives her somewhere to belong. Cheerful surface with wistful minor-color chords underneath. Busy little phrases gradually leave meaningful rests, opening into a gentle spacious middle section, then return with easy unforced joy. Youthful, sincere, comforting, not childish; memorable melody and light movement, dialogue-friendly mix. Finish with the initial groove ready to repeat. Pure instrumental, no vocal textures.
tracks.exclude_styles: vocals, humming, choir, spoken words, vocal chops, idol chants, crowd cheers, nursery music, lead piano ballad, orchestral drama, aggressive EDM drops, sound effects

tracks.title: わたしの声で — レイのテーマ
tracks.story_basis: 誰かを迎える居場所を作りたくて配信を始めた。強いキャラクターの笑顔に隠れていた、本当に好きな話を自分の声で届けたい気持ちを取り戻す。
tracks.musical_identity: 124 BPM・4/4。クリーンなエレキギターとアナログシンセ。強気のフックから素朴な中間部へ。
tracks.style_prompt: Instrumental melodic synth-pop rock character theme, 124 BPM, 4/4, 2-3 minutes. Clean electric guitar carries a confident octave-leaping hook, warm analog synth answers, melodic electric bass and tight syncopated live-style drums, soft electric piano underneath. A small livestream creator hides fatigue behind a fearless avatar; she wants to welcome lonely listeners home and finally talk about what she truly loves. Bright polished neon energy gives way to an intimate electric-piano and bass bridge; the hook returns warmer and less guarded, not louder or more aggressive. Catchy, bittersweet, resilient, genuine warmth, clear melodic identity, controlled dynamics suitable for a narrative game. Compact intro and a gentle return to the opening groove. Entirely instrumental, no voice.
tracks.exclude_styles: vocals, humming, choir, spoken words, vocal chops, crowd cheers, heavy metal, distorted shredding, big-room EDM, trailer percussion, sound effects
